existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: `StructureMap` has multiple local R4-to-R6 breaking changes. The top migration concerns are removed/replaced rule syntax (`defaultValue[x]`, `target.contextType`, `dependent.variable`), required terminology changes (`typeMode='none'`, `listMode='collate'`), and R6-only features that cannot be emitted as standard R4. The main uncertainty is exact intended runtime equivalence for old `collate` versus new `single` and for type-oriented target contexts.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: Treat StructureMap migration as a map-language migration rather than a simple JSON rename. Rewrite removed elements, review required code changes, run transformed maps through the intended StructureMap engine, and separately define downgrade behavior for R6-only constants, date/time parameters, empty groups, and anonymous rules.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: Confidence is high for validation and wire-format findings because they come directly from local R4/R6 StructureDefinition snapshots and bound CodeSystems. Confidence is lower for exact runtime equivalence of some semantic changes because official narrative diffs, ConceptMaps, and engine execution tests were not available.

compatibilityLeverage.note: Resource-level leverage is a planning signal. It does not mark individual Revisit findings as justified or unimportant.

rationaleMd:
StructureMap keeps its resource identity. The aggregate has 5 hard R4-to-R6 instance break(s), 1 potential hard break(s), 4 non-mechanical migration finding(s), and 1 direct behavior/API finding(s).

R4 maturity context is trial-use/FMM 2, which creates neutral stability pressure.

The computed migration-unavoidability score is 75/100, producing migration shape `moderate-targeted-remodel`, major migration `Partial`, and compatibility posture `preserve-where-low-cost-but-expect-resource-migration`.

11 shared Resource/DomainResource behavior finding(s) are listed as context but not scored for this resource to avoid duplicating base behavior issues across all resources.
recommendedStandardsPostureMd: Expect targeted migration work, but continue reviewing individual breaks. Use less-breaking designs where they do not preserve obsolete or conflicting models indefinitely.

topFindings.title: target.contextType was removed and target.context became variable-oriented string context
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid and runtime/API/codegen: R4 maps with `target.contextType` fail the R6 structure and generated model property expectations; dropping or rewriting the discriminator is needed before engines can process the R6 form.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: group.typeMode no longer permits required-binding code 'none'
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 maps with `typeMode = none` use a required-bound code that no longer exists in R6 and must be transformed to omission.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: target.listMode removes 'collate' and adds 'single' in a required binding
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid and runtime/API/codegen: R4 maps using `collate` fail R6 terminology validation and engines cannot safely infer whether `single` is the intended behavior.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: dependent.variable was replaced by dependent.parameter
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid and runtime/API/codegen: R4 `variable` array entries are not valid R6 dependent arguments and generated code must use the new `parameter` backbone.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: source.defaultValue[x] was replaced by a string-valued source.defaultValue
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 instances using non-string `defaultValue[x]` properties are outside the R6 element shape and require conversion before validation or execution.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Rule source min/max cardinality validation was tightened
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: some R4 maps that passed structural validation because of loose integer/string typing now fail R6 validation when cardinality values are nonsensical.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: R6 consolidates many per-resource canonical SearchParameter URLs into multi-base CanonicalResource and MetadataResource definitions
topFindings.whyRelevant: Behavior/API finding whose affectedResources include this resource, or shared context when listed under sharedBehaviorContext.

topFindings.title: R6 adds root StructureMap.const for named constant values
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: R6-to-R4 loss: R6 maps that rely on `const` need expansion or transformation for R4 processors, but existing R4 maps do not break.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: R6 permits groups with no rules and rules without names
